review:
Fortune Bells is a modern classic built around the bell, one of the oldest slot symbols, in many variations. It uses a 5x3 layout with 10 lines.

Wilds double any winning combination they complete in the main game. Fifteen free spins come with a 3x multiplier on every win and unlimited retriggers. BGaming describes the maths as designed for regular, balanced payouts, though it rates the game high volatility, with a 4,684x maximum. The RTP of 97.09% is excellent. Free spins arrive about once every 156 spins. It's the same core design as Lady Wolf Moon and Lucky Dama Muerta, with a traditional look.
